# Billy Lush Insurance

> Billy Lush Insurance is William "Billy" Lush, a licensed life insurance agent based in Newbury Park, California, serving the Conejo Valley, all of California, and Texas. He helps families set up term life, whole life, final expense, and indexed universal life (IUL) coverage in plain English, with a focus on making sure money reaches a family quickly after a death instead of getting stuck in probate. He is also the baker behind Billy Bread, a Newbury Park cottage bakery.

## Key facts
- Agent: William "Billy" Lush, individual licensed life insurance agent
- California license: #4247326 (verify: https://cdicloud.insurance.ca.gov/cal/LicenseNumberSearch?handler=Search&licenseNumber=4247326)
- Texas license: #3268220
- Based in: Newbury Park, California (Ventura County)
- Serves: Newbury Park, Thousand Oaks, Westlake Village, Oak Park, Agoura Hills, Moorpark, Camarillo, Simi Valley, the rest of California, and Texas
- Products: term life, whole life, final expense, indexed universal life (IUL)
- Carrier appointments include John Hancock, Nationwide, American General (AIG), Fidelity & Guaranty, North American, Sagicor, AuguStar, and Life Insurance Co. of the Southwest
- Approach: a free, no-pressure 15-minute conversation; he tells people when they do not need something
- Phone and text: (323) 580-9137
- Email: billy@billylushinsurance.com
- Book a time: https://calendly.com/billylush/15min
- Website: https://billylushinsurance.com

## Background
- Billy Lush is also a working actor (Generation Kill on HBO, For All Mankind on Apple TV+) and the founder of Billy Bread (https://billybread.com), a sourdough bakery in Newbury Park
- His wife, Anne Clare Lush (https://anneclarelush.com), works separately in probate real estate. They are two independently licensed professionals who refer to each other, not a single firm
